title: Asiad: Sibol ousts South Korea, advances to Honor of Kings semifinals for sure bronze
summary: Sibol pulled off a quarterfinal statement win over South Korea on Sunday, punching its ticket to the Honor of Kings semis at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya.
